maya: Quick heads-up — qbench run for the new q4b-int4 bringup shows a 4.2% F1 drop on our golden promptset vs prod. Noticing concentration on long-dialog and code snippets. Can curation + quant team triage?

aj_s: Ack. Do you have a minimal reproducer or sample ids where it regressed?

maya: Pasting a tiny sample list and a query to pull nearby duplicates. Most failures are borderline hallucinations + truncated completions.

maya: ```sql
-- find prompt fingerprints with multiple samples
SELECT fingerprint, array_agg(sample_id) as samples, count(*)
FROM prompts
WHERE created_at > '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

aya: (typo) maya: ^^^ run that against samplebank.curated

tess_curation: I can take the dedupe pass today. Planning: 1) run the fingerprint query, 2) sample inspect top 200 collisions, 3) mark true duplicates for merge, 4) surface ambiguous ones to labelers as review tasks. ETA noon PT.

labeling-bot: Queue snapshot created: lab-queue-20260321-01, size 412 tasks. Estimated throughput @ current capacity: 80/day.

sanjay_q: For quant team: let's hold off on wide rollouts until dedupe + golden refresh. I suspect KV-cache prefix differences + tokenization edgecases are amplified by int4 kernel. Can you add a targeted canary set (50-100 examples) that reproduce regression? We'll run int8 vs int4 vs fp16 on that set.

olga: I'll own golden augmentation. Propose adding 120 edge cases across: long-dialog truncation (40), code + mixed markdown (40), paraphrase-heavy prompts (40). We'll label these as 'golden-aug-20260321' and pin them for the next two qbench runs.

tess_curation: For labeler routing: we should prioritize the ambiguous collisions and the new golden-aug tasks. I'll open a short runbook for labelers: decision rules, merge vs relabel.

maya: Thanks all. Two asks: (1) tess — after dedupe can you publish a short CSV of removed/merged sample_ids so evals can ignore them? (2) sanjay — can you paste the command you want for the local qbench run so I can kick it off?

aj_s: Re (1) — we'll also need a mapping file for sample_id -> canonical_id for provenance.

labeling-bot: lab-queue-20260321-01: assigned 60 tasks to team A, 60 to team B, remainder unassigned. ETA for first 60 done ~ 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC.

sanjay_q: Command for local qbench quick run (example):

```bash
# run with two variants, capture token-level diffs
qbench run --model prod-model:tag --model new-q4b-int4:tag \
  --eval-set golden-aug-20260321 --output qbench/3467891234/ \
  --capture-token-diffs --max-examples 200
```

sanjay_q: We'll add a --quant-inspect flag to dump kv-cache lengths and tokenization hashes.

olga: FYI I'll also add an eval hook to surface examples where top-1 differs but top-3 contains prod answer — helps classify regressions vs reranking issues.

maya: Awesome. If possible let's gate the new model on: dedupe pass complete + golden-aug in qbench + int8 baseline shows no worse than -1% F1. Otherwise fallback to prod-model.

aj_s: I'll update the rollout policy to add that gate.

maya: Thanks — will follow up with a short summary when we have the dedupe CSV and first qbench outputs. :thumbsup:

labeling-bot: lab-queue-20260321-01: 120 tasks accepted by labelers; 18 completed so far.
